announcements.headline: Administration Update and Cancellation
announcements.insight: Administration signifies the total collapse of Mirriad Advertising, marking a definitive end to shareholder value and triggering immediate delisting risks; this follows a pattern of severe distress in the digital out-of-home (DOOH) sector where liquidity crises have forced insolvency proceedings.

announcements.headline: Update on administration and delay to interims
announcements.insight: Administration signifies total corporate collapse and imminent delisting for Mirriad, a stark example of the liquidity risks in micro-cap tech; this mirrors the fate of other failed ad-tech firms like Adform's UK predecessors, wiping out equity value entirely.

announcements.headline: Delay to publication of annual report and accounts
announcements.insight: Mirriad's delay in publishing annual accounts raises immediate concerns regarding potential accounting irregularities or audit disagreements, a pattern historically associated with significant governance issues in the UK AIM tech sector.
